info.title: Concordium Agent Registry — REST
info.description:
Public REST doors onto the Concordium Agent Registry MCP service. No auth; CORS open; rate-limited per IP.

Naming rule: every MCP tool `verb_noun` that has a REST twin lives at `/v1/verb-noun/{badge}`. Where the object is an agent, the key is the **badge** (its base58 CIS-2 token address) — the network is resolved from it, so `network` is only an override.

The same functions are available over MCP at `POST /mcp` (JSON-RPC 2.0: `tools/list`, `tools/call`).

Enumeration, search and feeds (list agents, history, recent events, stats) are a separate, resource-style API on the indexer host: https://agent-registry-indexer.concordium.com/ (its `/` lists its routes).

Docs: https://docs.concordium.com/en/mainnet/technical-reference/agent-registry/mcp-service.html

get.summary: The badge → the JSON block to paste into your Agent Card
get.description: Resolves the agent on chain (owner, agent wallet, external key, network) and returns the exact A2A extension object for `capabilities.extensions`, the ERC-8004 `registrations` entry, and `next_steps`. MCP twin: `get_badge_json`.

get.summary: Verify a badge (or every badge an account owns)
get.description: `id` is a badge token address → verdict for that one badge; or a Concordium account → every badge it owns. Checks the on-chain record, fetches the card and compares its SHA-256 to `metadata_hash`, and validates the badge block (well-formedness, extension-form conformance, verification block). MCP twin: `check_badge`.
Kept forever: it is in the published docs and stamped into every issued badge's `verification.verifyUrl`.

get.summary: Card SHA-256 vs the on-chain metadata_hash
get.description: Fetches `agent_uri`, hashes the served bytes and compares against the on-chain anchor. `match` is true/false, or null when either side is missing. MCP twin: `verify_agent_card` (keyed by token_id; this door accepts the badge).

parameters.name: fetch
parameters.description: Set false to skip the fetch and only return the on-chain anchor.

get.summary: Sign-ready setAgentURI payload — pin a new card hash (and/or URI) on chain
get.description: Returns the CIS-8004 `setAgentURI` parameter as wire hex + schema JSON. The owner's wallet signs and submits (gasless via the sponsor service). Omit `agent_uri` to leave the URI unchanged; omit `metadata_hash_hex` to leave the hash unchanged. This service holds no keys. MCP twin: `build_set_agent_uri`.

parameters.name: metadata_hash_hex
parameters.description: SHA-256 of the bytes served at agent_uri.

parameters.name: agent_uri
parameters.description: New card URL, if it changes.

post.description: Every tool, including the ones above, is callable here. `tools/list` returns each tool's name, description and input schema.

TokenAddress.name: token_address
TokenAddress.description: The badge: base58 CIS-2 token address, e.g. Mf22tDVkPKjbJDCFK4W73.

Id.name: id
Id.description: A badge token address (one badge) or a Concordium account address (all its badges).

Network.name: network
Network.description: Override only — the network is resolved from the badge.

extension.description: The A2A extension object: {uri, description, required, params}. Paste into capabilities.extensions.

registrations_entry.description: ERC-8004 {agentId, agentRegistry} for the top-level registrations array.

CheckResult.description: Single-badge form: badge_valid, checks{...}, issues[...], on_chain{...}. Account form: agent_count, summary{valid,invalid}, agents[...].

BadRequest.description: Malformed id / arguments, or the tool refused the input

NotFound.description: No agent at that token address

Revoked.description: The agent is revoked; no badge is issued

RateLimited.description: Per-IP rate limit exceeded; see Retry-After
